intro: MCP servers configured on your paired desktop. You can switch a server or an individual tool off from here; adding, editing and authenticating a server is done on the desktop.
manageOnDesktop: Adding, editing, deleting and authenticating MCP servers happens on the desktop — open Settings → MCP there. Rules that match tools by name are edited there too.
rulesOnDesktop: Tools held off by a name rule can only be freed on the desktop.
